external_entities.name: sensor node
external_entities.description: A sensor node installed at a customer site that publishes readings and polls for firmware images.
external_entities.source_excerpt: We have a few thousand sensor nodes installed on customer sites.
external_entities.notes: Nodes are outside the organisation's physical control.

external_entities.name: field technician
external_entities.description: A technician who services sensor nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.

external_entities.name: fleet operator
external_entities.description: An internal operator who views telemetry dashboards.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network

processes.name: device gateway
processes.description: An MQTT broker running on GKE that accepts readings from sensor nodes.
processes.source_excerpt: the device gateway, which is an MQTT broker we run on GKE

processes.name: telemetry normalizer
processes.description: A Python consumer in the analytics network that processes readings before storing them.
processes.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

processes.name: serial console
processes.description: A local console used by field technicians to service sensor nodes.
processes.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
processes.notes: The source does not say whether the console has authentication.

processes.name: dashboard
processes.description: A dashboard used by fleet operators to view telemetry over BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery

data_stores.name: device registry
data_stores.description: A Firestore registry used to check device keys and identify the customer associated with a node.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to

data_stores.name: Pub/Sub
data_stores.description: A messaging service carrying accepted readings to the telemetry normalizer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_stores.name: telemetry lake
data_stores.description: A BigQuery store containing site addresses and occupancy patterns from sensor readings.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns in it, so it is customer data.

data_stores.name: firmware bucket
data_stores.description: A Cloud Storage bucket from which sensor nodes retrieve firmware images.
data_stores.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image
data_stores.notes: The bucket is public read. The source does not say whether nodes verify a signature before installing an image.

data_flows.name: publish readings
data_flows.description: A sensor node publishes readings to the device gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway
data_flows.notes: The fleet-wide pre-shared key is not per device and has not been rotated since deployment.

data_flows.name: look up device
data_flows.description: The device gateway looks up a device in the device registry.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway looks up the device in a device registry (Firestore)
data_flows.data_description: device key and customer association lookup

data_flows.name: forward readings
data_flows.description: The device gateway forwards accepted readings onto Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_flows.name: pick up readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer picks up readings from Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: picked up by the telemetry normalizer

data_flows.name: write readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer writes readings into the telemetry lake.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which writes them into the telemetry lake in BigQuery
data_flows.data_description: sensor readings, including site addresses and occupancy patterns

data_flows.name: poll image
data_flows.description: A sensor node polls the firmware bucket for a new image.
data_flows.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image
data_flows.notes: The bucket is public read. The source does not say whether the node checks a signature before installing the image.

data_flows.name: service node
data_flows.description: A field technician services a sensor node over the local serial console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
data_flows.notes: The source does not say what authentication the console has, if any.

data_flows.name: view dashboard
data_flows.description: A fleet operator views dashboards from the corporate network using company SSO.
data_flows.source_excerpt: fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network, signed in with company SSO

data_flows.name: read telemetry
data_flows.description: The dashboard reads telemetry over BigQuery.

trust_boundaries.name: customer sites
trust_boundaries.description: Sites controlled by customers where sensor nodes are installed.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: sensor nodes installed on customer sites

trust_boundaries.name: GKE
trust_boundaries.description: The GKE environment where the device gateway runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: an MQTT broker we run on GKE

trust_boundaries.name: analytics network
trust_boundaries.description: The network in which the telemetry normalizer runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which fleet operators access dashboards.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry lake's data is confidential.
assumptions.basis: The source says the lake contains site addresses and occupancy patterns and identifies it as customer data.

assumptions.assumption: The firmware bucket's data is public.
assumptions.basis: The source explicitly says the Cloud Storage bucket is public read.
